title: Every instance with Hindsight runs the same version and build

shown.what: Installed version and build of Hindsight on each component

title: Hindsight's server inventory holds the version this search head really runs

shown.what: version recorded for p-mgmt's own GUID in Hindsight's server inventory

search.query: | inputlookup hindsight_server_inventory | eval g=lower(guid) | join type=inner g [| rest splunk_server=local /services/server/info | eval g=lower(guid) | fields g] | head 1 | fields version

expected.what: version from splunkd server/info on p-mgmt

title: Hindsight records each server's real Splunk version

shown.what: version in Hindsight's server inventory, per server

search.query: | inputlookup hindsight_server_inventory | search hostname="{each}" | head 1 | fields version

expected.what: version from each server's own splunkd server/info

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local /services/server/info | eval guid=upper(guid) | fields version

title: Hindsight records each server under its real GUID

shown.what: guid in Hindsight's server inventory, per server

search.query: | inputlookup hindsight_server_inventory | search hostname="{each}" | head 1 | eval guid=upper(guid) | fields guid

expected.what: guid from each server's own splunkd server/info

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local /services/server/info | eval guid=upper(guid) | fields guid

title: Hindsight's server inventory holds every search peer and the search head itself

shown.what: number of servers in Hindsight's server inventory

search.query: | inputlookup hindsight_server_inventory | stats dc(guid) as value

expected.what: p-mgmt's own distributed search peers, plus itself

search.query: | rest splunk_server=local count=0 /services/search/distributed/peers | stats dc(guid) as peers | eval value=peers+1 | fields value

title: Hindsight records each lab forwarder's real version

shown.what: version in Hindsight's forwarder inventory, per forwarder

search.query: | inputlookup hindsight_forwarder_inventory | search hostname="{each}" | head 1 | fields version

expected.what: the version tag of the image each forwarder container runs

title: No finding recommends an upgrade to a version the host already runs or has passed

shown.what: findings whose recommended upgrade is not newer than the host's version

search.query: | inputlookup hindsight_findings | eval p=split(version,".") | eval vs=printf("%04d%04d%04d%04d", tonumber(mvindex(p,0)), tonumber(coalesce(mvindex(p,1),"0")), tonumber(coalesce(mvindex(p,2),"0")), tonumber(coalesce(mvindex(p,3),"0"))) | where isnotnull(upgrade_sort) AND upgrade_sort!="" AND upgrade_sort<=vs | stats count as value

expected.what: the rule: an upgrade target is always a later version

title: Hindsight records the Pulse Spoke version Bravo really has installed

shown.what: version of federation_pulse_spoke on p-bravo in Hindsight's app inventory

search.query: | inputlookup hindsight_app_inventory | search server=p-bravo app_id=federation_pulse_spoke | head 1 | fields version

title: Hindsight records the Pulse HQ version the HQ search head really has installed

shown.what: version of federation_pulse_hq on p-hq-sh1 in Hindsight's app inventory

search.query: | inputlookup hindsight_app_inventory | search server=p-hq-sh1 app_id=federation_pulse_hq | head 1 | fields version
